107 likes, 3 comments - assetyogi on October 6, 2026: "Post Office Monthly Income Scheme (MIS) is one of the best ways to lock in regular income at 7.4% p.a.

Lumpsum Deposit: Invest once and receive monthly interest payouts directly into your account for 5 years

Max Deposit up to ₹9 Lakhs (Single) or ₹15 Lakhs (Joint)

Early Exit Penalty

Year 1: Locked in (No withdrawal)
Year 1–3: 2% deduction
Year 3–5: 1% deduction

Taxation as per your slab rate (No TDS at source)

[MIS, Post Office Scheme, Regular Income]

#mis #assetyogi #personalfinance".
